content.summary: Shares of  Signet Jewelers  fell Tuesday after the parent company of retailers like Kay, Zales, and Jared beat quarterly earnings expectations but projected a difficult holiday season.  Signet posted adjusted earnings of 63 cents a share for its fiscal third quarter, ahead of analysts’ consensus estimates of 29 cents.
